描述_EN: the rolling ball emitting red flames which the dragon is purchasing, is balanced below by a peony flower, and between the two in the centre of the composition, there is a large chinese character, shuang xi (double happiness), the emblem of wedded bliss. panel of crimson silk satin, embroidered in coloured silks and gold thread. the design composed of a five-clawed dragon and a phoenix surrounded by sprays of peony, peach blossom, and olea fragrans, interwoven with tendrilled branches of the pilgrim gourd (hu lu).
